access.forbidden: This section is for the restaurant's administration only. If you need access, ask whoever manages Marea Baja.

errors.network: We can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete that. Please try again.
errors.load: We couldn't load this information. Reload the page.
errors.RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload the page to see the current version.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: Another menu item already uses that identifier.
errors.PRICE_INCREMENT: The amount must be a multiple of the currency's rounding increment.
errors.CURRENCY_CHANGE_BLOCKED: There are active orders: the currency can only change when there are none.
errors.ADMIN_SELF_CHANGE: You can't change your own account here.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active administrator account must remain.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You made many changes in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account isn't allowed to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that. It may no longer exist.
errors.ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT: The order changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page.
errors.ORDER_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order can no longer be cancelled in its current status.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: That payment action isn't allowed right now.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED: The refund is more than the captured amount still to be returned.
errors.GATEWAY_ERROR: The demo processor rejected the operation. Nothing changed; you can retry.

fields.increment: It must be a multiple of the rounding increment.
fields.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, no spaces.
fields.range: The opening time must be before the closing time.
fields.overlap: It overlaps another time range on the same day.
fields.money: Type the amount in numbers, without a currency symbol.
fields.reason: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.

common.reasonHint: It's kept in the audit log.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.intro: First, what's waiting for work; then the period's figures, from real order data.
dashboard.salesNote: Orders the restaurant accepted count (from confirmed to delivered). Cancelled orders don't count; partial refunds are subtracted.
dashboard.otherCurrency: {{n}} orders in this period are in another currency and aren't added up.
dashboard.topEmpty: No accepted orders in this period yet.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: All orders, newest first. Refunds and cancellations are made from the order details.
orders.searchHint: Order code (MB-…), customer name or email.

order.title: Order details
order.nothingToRefund: There's nothing captured left to refund.
order.refundDone: Refund recorded. It's a demo operation: no real money moved.
order.refundAmountError: Enter an amount greater than 0 and no more than the captured amount still to be returned.
order.refundHint: Full or partial. The order status doesn't change: to cancel it, use the cancellation.
order.cancelDone: Cancellation requested. The order is cancelled when the payment operation finishes.
order.cancelVoid: The demo card authorization is voided and the order is cancelled.
order.cancelRefund: The captured amount still to be returned is refunded and the order is cancelled.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: Categories and dishes with their English translation. Price and availability changes show on the public menu right away.
menu.emptyCategory: This category has no dishes yet.
menu.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It can't be changed later.

product.title: Edit dish
product.name: Original name
product.priceHintCrc: In whole colones, with no symbol or separators. Example: 8900.
product.priceHintUsd: In dollars, with up to two decimals. Example: 17.80.
product.availableHint: Unchecked, the menu shows it as "Sold out today".
product.activeHint: Unchecked, the dish leaves the public menu.
product.enNameHint: Only if the original is descriptive and worth translating. Otherwise, leave it empty.
product.photoHint: At this stage only the alternative text can be edited. Photo uploads come with the deployment.
product.previewHint: This is how the line will look on the menu.
product.optionsHint: Each group is saved separately. The surcharge is added to the dish price.

catch.title: Catch of the day
catch.intro: The board on the home page. Prepare today's or tomorrow's and publish it when it's ready.
catch.published: Board published. It's now on the home page.
catch.saved: Draft saved. It isn't published yet.
catch.statusNone: There's no board for this day yet.
catch.lastItem: The board needs at least one species.
catch.max: The board allows up to 12 species.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Registered accounts, with their roles and status.
customers.name: Name

customer.title: Customer
customer.noOrders: This account hasn't placed any orders yet.
customer.selfNote: This is your own account: someone else in the administration changes your roles and access.
customer.reasonHint: Required to change roles or block. It's kept in the audit log.

roleHint.CUSTOMER: Can order and track their orders.
roleHint.STAFF: Runs the Pass: confirms and moves orders forward.

customer.oneRole: The account needs at least one role.
customer.blockHint: Blocking closes all their sessions at once and stops them from signing in until unblocked.
customer.blockedDone: {{name}} is blocked and their sessions were closed.
customer.rolesDone: {{name}}'s roles were updated. They apply on their next action.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Restaurant operation, opening hours, sign-in protection, taxes, delivery zones and currency. Every change is kept in the audit log.
settings.pricesIncludeTaxHint: Value approved for the demo: included (D5). It's a demo setting, not tax advice.
settings.roundingHint: Prices must be multiples of this amount.
settings.hoursHint: Local time ({{timezone}}). An unchecked day is closed.
settings.turnstileHint: When an account reaches this number of failed sign-ins within the window, sign-in asks for the human check. It's never shown to everyone.
settings.threshold: Failures before asking for the check
settings.taxesHint: They apply to new orders. Each order keeps a copy of what it was charged.

currency.title: Currency
currency.hint: Changing the currency converts menu prices, surcharges, delivery fees and the minimum order in a single operation. Existing orders keep their currency.
currency.blocked: There are {{n}} active orders. The currency change is enabled when there are none left.
currency.done: Currency changed to {{currency}}: {{products}} dishes and {{zones}} zones converted.
currency.rateHint: For example 510.25. Up to two decimals, with a dot.
currency.confirm: You're about to convert the whole menu from {{from}} to {{to}} at 1 USD = {{rate}} CRC. Check some prices on the menu afterwards.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Read-only record of changes made by staff and by the system. Emails appear masked.
audit.actionHint: Start of the action, for example product. or settings.currency
audit.bySystem: The system or an owner script
